biotools.summary: ORION-FISH is a workflow that integrates high-plex tissue imaging with a DNA fluorescence in situ hybridization (DNA-FISH) workflow and single-cell registration to map genomic alterations (copy-number changes) alongside protein-defined cell states in intact tissues.
